findings.evidence: NfcCoordinator correctly isolates active RF reads for state machine reconciliation, collects NdefMessage instances in memory during operation, and defers diagnostic hashing and SharedPreferences persistence (capped at 20 entries) to a post-close finally block guarded against outcome modification. Null/empty read wording cleanly avoids claiming the tag was never written, and all acceptance tests pass in deferred-diagnostics-build.log.
